tools.name: getClaim
tools.description: Fetch a Bitcraft land claim (settlement) by its entity id, including owner, tier, and metadata.

claimId.description: Numeric entity id of the claim.

tools.name: getMarketPrice
tools.description: Look up current buy and sell orders for a Bitcraft item or cargo on the BitJita market.

itemId.description: Numeric id of the item or cargo.

tools.name: searchPlayer
tools.description: Search BitJita for a Bitcraft player by username substring. Returns up to 50 matches.

query.description: Username or substring to search for.
